instruction: Curved rice terraces stepping down a hillside at sunrise: water-filled paddies mirroring the orange sky, young green rice rows, narrow grass bunds, a stilted farmer's hut, a water buffalo by a muddy pool, palm clusters, a winding footpath, and white egrets. user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Terraced Rice Fields. Curved rice terraces stepping down a hillside at sunrise: water-filled paddies mirroring the orange sky, young green rice rows, narrow grass bunds, a stilted farmer's hut, a water buffalo by a muddy pool, palm clusters, a winding footpath, and white egrets. The paddy water shimmers as a breeze crosses the terraces. Style: pastoral stylized. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
